subject.title: [Analysis] Identify performance bottlenecks in native OpenClaw setup on constrained VPS

question: What scope and acceptance criteria should this native Linux VPS performance investigation use before ClawSweeper queues any implementation work?
rationale: The issue is useful and aligned, but the repository does not yet define the measurement environment, whether estimates are acceptable, or which missing spans should block completion.

options.title: Scope a runbook first
options.body: Document the exact native Linux measurement recipe and required signals, then open narrow follow-ups only for measured missing spans or hot paths.

options.title: Sponsor a broader observability project
options.body: Treat the issue as a maintainer-owned performance program that can span agents, memory, channels, hooks, and provider routing.

options.title: Leave as support guidance only
options.body: Keep current docs and telemetry as-is and answer the reporter with existing diagnostics rather than adding a new repo artifact.

recommendation.title: Scope a runbook first
recommendation.body: Document the exact native Linux measurement recipe and required signals, then open narrow follow-ups only for measured missing spans or hot paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent appears in the most central current blame and recent history for the diagnostics and docs surfaces this investigation would synthesize.
